prompt:
Create a looping animation of a humanoid character pushing an object forward with a broom. Lower body must stay completely still: hips, upper legs, lower legs, feet, and toes remain fixed in place with no motion or weight shift. Only the spine, chest, shoulders, arms, and hands may move.
Character leans slightly forward from the spine. Both hands hold the broom; upper hand near chest, lower hand near waist. Broom head stays on the ground directly behind the object.
Perform a small, controlled forward push: arms extend slightly to drive the object away. After each push, make a short reset by sliding the broom back just enough to start the next push. Do not allow the torso or arms to pull backward past the neutral position. Keep the movement subtle and forward-biased, with no lifting of the broom. Loop cleanly without pops.
